name: sensor_classifier
claim_text: 1. A system comprising: a processor configured to receive sensor data; and a memory storing instructions to classify the sensor data.

prior_art_texts.title: Sensor classification system
prior_art_texts.abstract: A processor receives sensor measurements and classifies the measurements using stored instructions.
prior_art_texts.claims: 1. A system including a processor and memory for processing sensor measurements.
prior_art_texts.description: [0042] The processor receives sensor data from an input interface. [0043] Memory stores instructions that classify the sensor data.
